<div class="country-note-groups country-note-groups--case-management">
<details class="country-note-group">
<summary>
<span>Country-specific policy context</span>
<small>1 note</small>
</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Policy note</h4>
<p>Changed to 7-day PQ in 2023; Follow-up days changed 2023 when there was a switch from 14 day PQ to low dose 7-day PQ. Before the switch to high-dose 7 day, VMW follow up was conducted at patients home checking for adherence and side effects, and partially implemented due to feasibility considerations. It also included DOT according to guidelines was not implemented as DOT; Tafenoquine is included the 2025 update but needs country regulatory approval; Quinine can be used as second line if AL is not available for malaria in first trimester of pregnancy.</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
</div>
